<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the Doebner modification. The forward reaction forms a C‑C double bond and breaks an aldehyde and a carboxylic acid (malonic acid decarboxylates). Using the allowed functional group names, we’ll search for templates that form “C-C double bonds” and break “aldehydes” and “aliphatic carboxylic acid”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "limit": 5
}
